sceneConcept: A reserved thirty-three-year-old Chinese underground engineering archive clerk stands alone against a transparent background. She has a neat dark-brown bob, round glasses and a quiet tired face. A muted blue cardigan, white collared shirt, straight black trousers and plain office shoes make her practical rather than managerial. She methodically holds and checks an open unmarked archive folder with blank folded plan sheets in both hands, looking down through her lenses; two fingertips show only thin reddish paper-cut marks, never wrappings or bandages. Soft even frontal studio light reveals the hands and papers without writing, scenery or a bright rim. Visual refresh: a brown sweater vest over rolled shirt sleeves with a long practical skirt.
naturalLanguageDetail: A reserved thirty-three-year-old Chinese engineering archive clerk with a neat dark-brown bob and round glasses holds an open unmarked folder of blank folded plans securely in both hands; two fingertips have only thin reddish paper-cut marks with no wrapping, under soft even frontal studio light without readable writing, scenery or a bright rim; a brown sweater vest over rolled shirt sleeves with a long practical skirt.
